races.name: William Hill Handicap Hurdle (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Indeevar Bleu
runners_data.comment: Progressive sort who won readily over C&D (upped from 2m) on Boxing Day; highly respected
runners_data.spotlight: Absent and had further wind surgery since his ready win over C&D (good to soft) on Boxing Day when proving well suited by the step up from 2m and taking record to 4-7; progressive and remains particularly unexposed at this trip; looks an ideal type for this assignment.

runners_data.name: Captain Teague
runners_data.comment: May be ready to hit top form; interesting off current mark given his back class
runners_data.spotlight: Has perhaps needed his two runs since a lengthy layoff, sixth to Fiercely Proud at Ascot latest; may be ready to hit top form and accordingly looks interesting off current mark when considering his back class (Grade 1 novice winner over 2m4f in December 2023).

runners_data.name: Joyeuse
runners_data.comment: Useful mare who ran respectably at the latest Cheltenham Festival; likely player
runners_data.spotlight: Useful mare whose handicap form at about 2m features a prestigious win last term and respectable third, with cheekpieces fitted, at the latest Cheltenham Festival (soft); ran well behind a very notable rival in one of her 2m4f attempts; likely player in the retained headgear and back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Fingle Bridge
runners_data.comment: Well beaten last time; penultimate effort wasn't bad but this is a stiffer task
runners_data.spotlight: Has failed to maintain an unbeaten hurdles record since returned this sphere, sweating and well beaten in the Imperial Cup (2m) last time; penultimate effort (2m5f) wasn't bad but this is a stiffer task.

runners_data.name: Act Of Authority
runners_data.comment: Posted another sound effort in the Martin Pipe; broadly consistent
runners_data.spotlight: Finished fifth with cheekpieces applied at the Cheltenham Festival (2m4f, soft) for another sound effort in the Martin Pipe; broadly consistent; likely to give his running in the retained headgear.

runners_data.name: Favour And Fortune
runners_data.comment: Placed in this race last year; each-way claims with Kempton reappearance under his belt
runners_data.spotlight: Acts on any going; successful in major handicap at Ayr two years ago; his two attempts at Aintree were good efforts in the 2023 Formby (second to highly notable rival) and this race last year (finished third); each-way claims back here with Kempton reappearance under his belt.

runners_data.name: Jet To Vegas
runners_data.comment: Below par in the Morebattle; bit to prove in another warm handicap
runners_data.spotlight: Returned to hurdles (from fences) with a below-par effort last time in the 2m Morebattle at Kelso, where he had won a 2m2f Grade 2 novice event 12 months earlier; bit to prove in another warm handicap.

runners_data.name: Ike Sport
runners_data.comment: Ran respectably in this race 12 months ago but otherwise an exposed 8yo
runners_data.spotlight: Ran respectably in this race 12 months ago (fifth off 3lb higher) and Cheltenham Festival handicap (3m) latest start; otherwise an exposed 8yo who is on a two-year losing spell; unlikely to come out on top.

runners_data.name: Wellington Arch
runners_data.comment: Successful in this race in 2025 and Uttoxeter event last time; again a big player
runners_data.spotlight: Justified favouritism in 2m4f event at Uttoxeter (soft) on Midlands National day, going one better than 12 months earlier and setting himself up perfectly for an attempt to win this prize for the second year running; current mark reflects his advancement; again a big player.

runners_data.name: Fiveonefive
runners_data.comment: Has done his winning at about 2m; far from consistent; opposed
runners_data.spotlight: Irish challenger who has done his winning at about 2m, mostly at Cartmel where he remains unbeaten; far from consistent and can be opposed in this highly competitive scenario back up in distance.

runners_data.name: Top Jimmy
runners_data.comment: Let down by his jumping last time; has a solid record otherwise; not written off
runners_data.spotlight: Novice hurdler who was let down by his jumping and eventually fell in the Imperial Cup when dropped back to 2m at Sandown most recently; has a solid record otherwise and some strong 2m4f form behind very notable rivals; may resume improvement, provided errors are avoided.

runners_data.name: Hot Fuss
runners_data.comment: Good second at the Cheltenham Festival upped to 2m4f; set for another big run
runners_data.spotlight: Has performed well in several notable handicaps, including a strong success at Windsor (2m; beat the subsequent County winner) in January and good second at the Cheltenham Festival (upped to 2m4f, soft) last time; solid contender who looks set for another big run.

runners_data.name: Rambo T
runners_data.comment: Has lost his form since winning a notable autumn prize; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Landed a notable handicap at Chepstow (2m3f, good; off just 1lb lower) in the autumn; not in anything like the same form since, always behind at the Cheltenham Festival (2m5f) most recently; other preferred.

runners_data.name: Faivoir
runners_data.comment: Has lots of good form but losing spell goes back three years
runners_data.spotlight: Has lots of form in major handicaps, generally at about 2m, but losing spell goes back three years and he looks unlikely to land this hot contest at the age of 11; remote third at Newbury most recently.

runners_data.name: Fiercely Proud
runners_data.comment: Has gained both handicap wins at Ascot; something to prove back at Aintree
runners_data.spotlight: Has gained both handicap wins in useful contests at Ascot (1m7f/2m3f); something to prove back at Aintree and finished behind some of today's rivals at the Cheltenham Festival (2m4f, soft) last time.

runners_data.name: Jazzy Matty
runners_data.comment: Nearly recorded a second win in Cheltenham Festival chase; has a lower hurdles mark
runners_data.spotlight: Better over fences; stays 2m5f; had wind surgery prior to the latest Cheltenham Festival (2m, good) where he very nearly recorded a second success in the Grand Annual; not guaranteed to transfer the form back to hurdles but he is attractively treated off a much lower mark in this sphere.

runners_data.name: Swindon Village
runners_data.comment: Record of 311 in 2m4f contests under rules; may have more to offer at this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Weakened late on (shaped better than bare result) in the 3m Grade 1 novice hurdle at the Cheltenham Festival; won with plenty to spare at Newbury (soft) the time before, taking 2m4f record under rules to 311, and may have more to offer over this distance; interesting handicap debutant.

runners_data.name: Trustintimes
runners_data.comment: Improving but goes into unknown territory trip-wise; looks suited by good ground
runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 5yo who has form figures of 11112, all at about 2m, since racing on good ground; ran well in a Kempton handicap at Christmas when last seen; improving but goes into unknown territory trip-wise and his chance also perhaps partly depends on the weather.

runners_data.name: Ballykinlar
runners_data.comment: Midfield at Cheltenham Festival on debut for new yard; needs to improve
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent results in Ireland this term featured three summer wins; not disgraced with midfield finish at the Cheltenham Festival (2m4f, soft) on debut for new stable but needs to improve on that bare form.

runners_data.name: Emid'io Pepe
runners_data.comment: Three hurdles wins in France; may improve further; interesting on British debut
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdles winner in France, prevailing narrowly in a Pau handicap (2m1f, very soft) last time; has joined the Skelton team and may be capable of significant further progress; intriguing contender, especially if the market speaks favourably.

runners_data.name: Sir Galahad
runners_data.comment: Attractively weighted and has possibilities with this new trip worth exploring
runners_data.spotlight: Solid novice hurdler at 2m from last spring to autumn, completing a four-timer (on good ground) prior to holding his form, running-on sixth in Grade 2 at Cheltenham the final occasion; attractively weighed and has possibilities with this new trip worth exploring.

runners_data.name: Bowmore
runners_data.comment: Campaigned mostly at about 2m; not crying out for this return to further
runners_data.spotlight: Campaigned mostly at about 2m and isn't crying out for this return to further; furthermore, he suffered a heavy defeat at the Cheltenham Festival most recently and this is another difficult task.

races.name: William Hill Mildmay Novices' Chase (Grade 1) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Salver
runners_data.comment: Huge effort when third in Grade 1 at Cheltenham last month; leading candidate
runners_data.spotlight: Can take a while to warm up but he impressed when slamming Doyen Quest in December Grade 2 at Sandown (good to soft) and again dispatched that rival at Windsor (also about 3m, soft; first-time cheekpieces) the following month; 25-1 but ran a scorcher, despite little going right, when flying from the rear to grab third in the Grade 1 Brown Advisory (3m1f) at Cheltenham last month; there's potential for a good gallop here, which will suit, and he holds leading claims.

runners_data.name: Regent's Stroll
runners_data.comment: Mercurial sort but fine effort at Cheltenham last time; up in trip and may do better yet
runners_data.spotlight: Nephew of Denman; has been a constant work in progress and pretty much lost the plot without a hood when third to Wendigo at Newbury (good to soft) in November; won a match on soft the following month but couldn't contain Miami Magic when second at Cheltenham in January; highly creditable third in the Jack Richards at Cheltenham (also about 2m4f, good; Golden Dancer second, Jordans Cross eighth) last month, however, and now goes up in trip with something deeper possibly lurking inside him.

runners_data.name: Miami Magic
runners_data.comment: Smart novice; beat Regent's Stroll in January; on the premises with clean round of jumping
runners_data.spotlight: Prominent-racer whose flop over hurdles at this meeting last year can be forgiven; scored on his third start over fences when beating Regent's Stroll by 4l at Cheltenham (about 2m4f, good) in January; jumping left plenty to be desired when third in Sandown Grade 1 later that month, however, and the race he won at Newbury (about 3m, good to soft) last time fell apart; he wasn't always fluent that day either but a clear round puts him on the premises.

runners_data.name: Jordans Cross
runners_data.comment: Disappointed last time but previously progressive; new trip has often looked worth a crack
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive 6yo who scored on his chase debut here (2m, good) in October; improved at about 2m4f subsequently, looking unlucky when falling at Cheltenham in November before winning his next two, including a fairly valuable event back there in January (soft); disappointing he could not get involved in the Jack Richards at the Cheltenham Festival (Gold Dancer second, Regent's Stroll third) last month but he has often shaped as if this step up in trip will suit; no surprise if he bounces back.

runners_data.name: Wendigo
runners_data.comment: Likeable; fell at the last when 6l down at Cheltenham latest; surely on the scene
runners_data.spotlight: Just nabbed on his chase debut (good) in October but stayed on strongly to pick up Newbury Grade 2 (also 2m4f, good to soft; Regent's Stroll third, Crest Of Fortune fourth) the following month; outpaced throughout but never stopped trying when third in Kempton Grade 1 (3m, good; Salver fourth, Crest Of Fortune behind) over Christmas and that was also the case until he fell at the last when 6l down in the Brown Advisory (3m1f, good to soft; Salver third) last month; solid claims.

runners_data.name: Doyen Quest
runners_data.comment: Put in his place by Salver on last two starts but arrives fresh; could go well at a price
runners_data.spotlight: Tends to lead; scored at 1-50 on his chase debut at Warwick in May and impressed when winning by 10l at Exeter (3m, also good) in November; put in his place by Salver on last two starts (good to soft/soft) but comes here fresh having skipped Cheltenham and any drying of the ground would be in his favour; could get them all at it.

runners_data.name: Gold Dancer
runners_data.comment: Career best when second at Cheltenham Festival latest; this trip looks worth another go
runners_data.spotlight: Experienced novice who had already won three chases by October; progress then stalled until he ran a screamer off top weight (ridden by 7lb claimer) when second in the Jack Richards at the Cheltenham Festival (about 2m4f, good; Regent's Stroll third, Jordans Cross eighth) last month; didn't stay 3m on sole attempt but that came on heavy ground and the experiment looks worth another go; player.

runners_data.name: Crest Of Fortune
runners_data.comment: Hasn't built on chase debut and had various issues on his last two starts; needs a revival
runners_data.spotlight: Third in the Grade 1 Sefton at this meeting last year but that wasn't the strongest renewal; promising second of 14 on chase debut at Cheltenham (2m4f, good) in October hasn't been built on and he bled when tailed off in Kempton Grade 1 over Christmas; didn't impress with his jumping in February when last seen and needs to get back on track.

runners_data.name: Sober Glory
runners_data.comment: Highly progressive; good second in the Supreme and that bare form can be marked up
runners_data.spotlight: Seems versatile as regards ground; highly progressive sort whose overall record is 7-9; has looked best over hurdles when making the running and impressively defied a big penalty at Newbury for his most recent success; good second in the Supreme at Cheltenham, despite a final-flight error and getting involved in some bumping on the run-in (bare form can be marked up); the pick on ratings.

runners_data.name: Baron Noir
runners_data.comment: Ran well in the Supreme; progressive and looks an Aintree type; warrants respect
runners_data.spotlight: Solid record (1312114) in bumpers and over hurdles for current yard, the most recent win at Kempton (2m, good; acts on soft); ties in with Sober Glory on two pieces of form, latest in the Supreme at Cheltenham where he fared best of the runners who raced towards the rear; warrants respect as he's progressive and looks an Aintree type.

runners_data.name: La Conquiere
runners_data.comment: Form dipped last time but progressive mare otherwise; first run against males
runners_data.spotlight: Has been campaigned exclusively against her own sex; form dipped at the Cheltenham Festival but may well rebound, with her record solid and progressive otherwise; close second in Grade 2 races at this meeting last year (bumper) and Ascot in January; admittedly faces a stiffer task in this first attempt against males.

runners_data.name: Sinnatra
runners_data.comment: Cheltenham Festival effort suggests this sharper scenario will suit; possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: Gained most recent win over 2m3f (straightforward task) but he's not short of speed and his handicap effort at the Cheltenham Festival (2m1f, soft; ran respectably) suggests this sharper scenario is likely to suit; the type who should still have more to offer; possibilities, provided he takes to first-time hood.

runners_data.name: Starting Fifteen
runners_data.comment: Sometimes free-going; this may prove more suitable than latest assignment
runners_data.spotlight: Sometimes free-going and has worn a hood since switched to hurdles, opening his account in Limerick event at Christmas; only seventh when 25-1 in Leopardstown Grade 1 at the Dublin Racing Festival (2m, heavy) but gives the impression he may fare better at this level when the ground is less testing.

runners_data.name: Storming George
runners_data.comment: Resumed his progress last time; ran well in bumper at this meeting last year
runners_data.spotlight: Resumed his progress with a clearcut success in novice handicap at Newbury (2m3f, good to soft) last time; has failed to shine in two Graded attempts over hurdles but may prove a brighter spark back at Aintree, having performed well (fifth of 15) in Grade 2 bumper at this meeting 12 months ago; has won over 2m.

runners_data.name: Grey Dawning
runners_data.comment: Ran well for long way in last month's Gold Cup; the drop back in trip could be a good move
runners_data.spotlight: Two Grade 1 wins, namely the 2m4f novice chase at the 2024 Cheltenham Festival (soft) and this season's Betfair Chase at Haydock (3m1f, good to soft); ran well for a long way before fading into fourth in last month's Gold Cup at Cheltenham (3m2f, good to soft); this drop back in trip could well be a positive move; effective here and respected in first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Heart Wood
runners_data.comment: 10l win in the Ryanair last month; tough to beat if reproducing same scintillating form
runners_data.spotlight: 8yo who made his Grade 1 breakthrough in the Ryanair at Cheltenham (2m4f, good) last month; that 10l victory was a career-best performance and he will be tough to beat if reproducing the same scintillating form today; ran well in the Mildmay at this meeting in 2024 on sole run here.

runners_data.name: L'Eau du Sud
runners_data.comment: Pretty solid performer in top 2m chases but doesn't appear to be crying out for this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Third of five in Grade 1 Maghull Novices' Chase here (2m, good) 12 months ago and reappeared with a win in the Grade 2 Shloer at Cheltenham (2m, soft) in November; ran well when 12l third in the Champion Chase at Cheltenham (2m, good to soft) last month but doesn't appear to be crying out for this step up in trip, and Harry Skelton rides Grey Dawning.

runners_data.name: JPR One
runners_data.comment: Bang there for a long way in the Ryanair; this less demanding track is a big plus
runners_data.spotlight: Proved his stamina when readily defying top weight in handicap at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft) in January, and he was disputing the lead entering the straight in the Ryanair at Cheltenham (2m4f, good) last month only to fade up the hill; beaten just over 16l by the winner Heart Wood but today's less demanding track should be a big plus; not ruled out each-way.

runners_data.name: Gidleigh Park
runners_data.comment: Pulled up in January but arrives fresh and last season's best performance came over C&D
runners_data.spotlight: Made mistakes and pulled up in the Clarence House at Ascot in January when last seen; however, prior to that he reappeared with a good second to subsequent Gold Cup runner-up Jango Baie in the Grade 2 1965 Chase at Ascot (2m5f, good) and last season's best performance came when runner-up in the Grade 1 Manifesto Novices' Chase over C&D (good to soft) in April; arrives fresh, whereas most of these ran at the Cheltenham Festival; interesting.

runners_data.name: Saint Segal
runners_data.comment: Progressive this season, with two handicap wins, but form needs to go to another new level
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive front-runner who has won two handicaps this term (2m3f/2m1f, good to firm/soft) and came second in the Grade 2 Game Spirit at Newbury (2m, heavy) in February; a bad mistake at the first fence all but ended his race in the Champion Chase at Cheltenham last month; sent off 50-1 at the Festival and his form has to go to a new level if he's to pose a threat today.

runners_data.name: Solness
runners_data.comment: Strong form when winning Grade 1 at Leopardstown in December; chance if seeing it out
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off at Leopardstown in February when the soft ground was against him and a visor replaced his usual cheekpieces, which return today; prior to that he posted a third Grade 1 win at Leopardstown (2m1f, yielding) in December; there's a question mark regarding the step back up in trip for this front-runner but his trainer won this twice in a row with Fakir d'Oudairies in 2021 and 2022, and this 8yo arrives fresh after just two starts this winter; chance.

races.name: Randox Topham Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Madara
runners_data.comment: Easily won the Plate at the Cheltenham Festival last month and 10lb rise may not stop him
runners_data.spotlight: 3-1 favourite when easily winning the 23-runner Plate at Cheltenham (2m4f, good to soft) last month in reapplied cheekpieces (retained); hit with a 10lb rise but that may not stop this 7yo, who could still have more to offer.

runners_data.name: Matata
runners_data.comment: Easy win at Cheltenham in January; mark perhaps not beyond him but return to form needed
runners_data.spotlight: Better than ever when easily winning at Cheltenham (2m4f, good) on New Year's Day and on that evidence this 5lb higher mark isn't necessarily beyond him; however, two lesser runs have followed; has to get back on track.

runners_data.name: Ile Atlantique
runners_data.comment: Inconsistent but represents Mullins/Townend and he followed Heart Wood home two starts ago
runners_data.spotlight: His form/jumping have been in and out since his Grade 2 novice chase win at Naas last January,  soundly beaten in a handicap at Leopardstown latest; however, two starts ago he followed Heart Wood home in a 2m7f Grade 3 at Tramore; could have a big say for Willie Mullins and Paul Townend.

runners_data.name: Boombawn
runners_data.comment: Only ninth in the Plate at Cheltenham but likes Aintree and he's on a dangerous mark
runners_data.spotlight: First run over the National fences; inconsistent this season and no match for stablemate Madara (who remains Harry Skelton's mount) when ninth of 23 in the Plate at Cheltenham last month; however, Aintree brought out the best in him last year and he's well handicapped on that form; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Viroflay
runners_data.comment: Front-runner who has done well in h'caps this season; could prove well suited by this test
runners_data.spotlight: Useful hunter chaser last season and he's transferred that form to handicaps, winning at Kempton (3m, good) in December and runner-up there (2m4f, good to soft) in February; he may be better going right-handed but otherwise this front-runner could prove well suited by today's test.

runners_data.name: Gentleman De Mee
runners_data.comment: Below best this season but same story last term prior to him winning this race
runners_data.spotlight: 10yo who hasn't been at his best this season but it was the same story last term prior to him winning this race (good to soft); he's just 3lb higher than 12 months ago and is capable of playing another leading role.

runners_data.name: Conflated
runners_data.comment: 3rd in 2023 Gold Cup; nothing like the force of old & this 12yo is probably up against it
runners_data.spotlight: Finished third in the 2023 Cheltenham Gold Cup; showed some spark around Punchestown's banks course this February but this 12yo is nothing like the force of old and was well beaten in the cross-country race at Cheltenham last month; without a win since December 2022 and looks up against it.

runners_data.name: Teddy Blue
runners_data.comment: Reluctant to line up at Kempton but it didn't stop him winning, making it 4-10 over fences
runners_data.spotlight: Can be difficult to settle and he was reluctant to line up at Kempton (2m4f, good) four weeks ago, but that didn't stop him winning; had just a neck to spare but the first two were clear and this 8yo is now 4-10 over fences; further progress is possible and he's not ruled out up just 3lb.

runners_data.name: Booster Bob
runners_data.comment: 2 wins last year and running well when falling at final fence in the Plate; each-way shout
runners_data.spotlight: Held by Madara and Will The Wise but running well when falling at final fence in the Plate at Cheltenham (2m4f, good to soft) last month; two wins during a progressive 2025 (2m4f/2m6f, soft/good to soft); each-way shout.

runners_data.name: Il Est Francais
runners_data.comment: 2024 King George runner-up; wind op since last time but pulled up on his last two starts
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner who is well handicapped on form shown as recently as December 2024, when runner-up in the King George at Kempton (3m, good), and he'll be a thrilling sight over these fences if back on song following wind surgery; however, pulled up on his last two starts and has plenty to prove.

runners_data.name: Soul Icon
runners_data.comment: Ninth in this last year, beaten nearly 20l, and he's just 3lb lower this time around
runners_data.spotlight: He's run pretty well in defeat at Kempton on his two starts this year (3m, good/good to soft); also ran okay when ninth in this last year (good to soft) but beaten nearly 20l and he's just 3lb lower this time around.

runners_data.name: Jipcot
runners_data.comment: Well beaten at Cheltenham but that may not be his track; each-way squeak on earlier form
runners_data.spotlight: 2lb out of the handicap today and well beaten in the Plate last month, but Cheltenham may not be his track; comfortably made all in small field at Leicester (2m6f, good to soft) in January and led into the straight at Ascot (3m, good to soft) in February, only to weaken; might have an each-way squeak.

runners_data.name: Eldorado Allen
runners_data.comment: Won a veterans' chase at Cheltenham in November but highly likely this 12yo is vulnerable
runners_data.spotlight: 12yo who staged a renaissance when winning a veterans' chase at Cheltenham in November and has continued in pretty good heart; however, it's likely he'll be vulnerable today; soundly beaten in this race 12 months ago.

runners_data.name: Croke Park
runners_data.comment: Hasn't kicked on this term but can go well if tapping back into last season's promise
runners_data.spotlight: Won two Grade 1 novice chases in December 2024 (2m4f/3m, yielding/good to yielding); he hasn't kicked on this term and was well beaten in a handicap at Leopardstown (2m5f, soft) in February, but getting back on better ground may help and he can go well if tapping back into last season's promise.

runners_data.name: O'Moore Park
runners_data.comment: 0-11 over fences; 6th of 23 in the Plate; represents Willie Mullins, so not discounted
runners_data.spotlight: 0-11 over fences and 14l behind Madara when sixth of 23 in the Plate at Cheltenham (2m4f, good to soft) last month; however, that was still a respectable run and the fact he represents Willie Mullins, who has won three of the last six runnings and saddles three today, means he's not discounted.

runners_data.name: Excello
runners_data.comment: Third of 17 in the Grand Sefton over C&D in November and he holds each-way possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: 4lb out of the handicap today and his losing sequence is up to 12 races; however, he ran pretty well when outstayed in the Kim Muir at Cheltenham (3m2f, good) last month and is racing off just 2lb higher than when third of 17 over C&D (good to soft) in the Grand Sefton in November; yard has won this five times and he holds each-way possibilities back down in trip.

runners_data.name: Primoz
runners_data.comment: Easy win in small field at Ayr last month; from out of the handicap he's 12lb higher today
runners_data.spotlight: Exploited a reduced mark to win easily in a small field at Ayr (2m4f, soft) last month and he's also effective on good/good to soft ground; his yard has done very well over these fences but from out of the handicap he's running off a mark 12lb higher than last time, and needs a career best.

runners_data.name: Addragoole
runners_data.comment: Ninth in the Grand Annual but Cheltenham may not be his track; only a 7yo; could go well
runners_data.spotlight: Stamina to prove and he failed to threaten when ninth in the Grand Annual last month; however, Cheltenham may not be his track (also not at his best there last October) and he showed improved form to win a competitive handicap at Leopardstown (2m1f, yielding) in December; only seven and there have been hints that this sort of trip may suit; no surprise to see him go well.

runners_data.name: Pour Les Filles
runners_data.comment: Hard to fancy on the face of it but yard has excellent record in this race over the years
runners_data.spotlight: Capitalised on the favourite falling three out to win in small field at Ffos Las (2m3f, soft) in January on stable debut and pulled up/well beaten on both runs since; hard to fancy on the face of it but his yard has an excellent record in this race over the years, so he's not a forlorn hope.

runners_data.name: Bill Baxter
runners_data.comment: Won this in 2023 and bumped into a well-treated novice at Kelso latest; could be involved
runners_data.spotlight: 10yo who won this in 2023 (soft); he's had his ups and downs since but won at Punchestown (3m, yielding) last May and bumped into a well-handicapped novice when runner-up at Kelso (2m7f, heavy) last time, following wind surgery; could give a good account and be involved.

runners_data.name: Peaky Boy
runners_data.comment: Could improve for last month's run in the Plate but others have more compelling claims
runners_data.spotlight: Showed abundant promise in late 2024 on his first two chase starts and is on a competitive mark on that form; remains lightly raced and he could improve for last month's run in the Plate at Cheltenham, when finishing mid-division, but others arrive with more compelling claims; a tongue-tie is added.

runners_data.name: Prairie Wolf
runners_data.comment: 9yo who has a career-high mark but has won three of his last four and is clearly thriving
runners_data.spotlight: Won over the regulation fences here (2m4f, good to soft) on Boxing Day and has bounced back from Cheltenham blip to win at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) and Newbury (2m4f, good to soft) on his last two starts; this 9yo has a career-high mark but is clearly thriving and not ruled out.

runners_data.name: The King Of Prs
runners_data.comment: Near 19l eighth in this last year, when 4lb higher than today; he's struggled this season
runners_data.spotlight: Won a quality handicap at Fairyhouse (2m1f, soft) last January and he ran okay when eighth in this last year, beaten nearly 19l; however, he's only 4lb lower this time around and has struggled this season.

runners_data.name: Hitman
runners_data.comment: Hasn't shone on last two starts but on handy mark; good record over regulation fences here
runners_data.spotlight: 10yo who has become inconsistent and hasn't shone on his last two starts; however, he has a good record over regulation fences here and has the same mark as when winning the Old Roan (2m4f, good to soft) last October; prominent for a fair way in last season's Grand National; not written off.

runners_data.name: Mahons Glory
runners_data.comment: 10yo who has a career-high mark, but this front-runner appears to relish these fences
runners_data.spotlight: 10yo who has a career-high mark following easy win in a small field at Huntingdon (2m4f, good to soft); however, he enjoyed himself in front in the Grand Sefton (2m5f, good to soft; fourth) and the Becher (3m2f, soft; fifth) over these fences earlier in the season and can make another bold bid.

runners_data.name: Lisnamult Lad
runners_data.comment: Well below best on both runs this season but runner-up in this last year; on the shortlist
runners_data.spotlight: Well below his best on both runs this season, the latest at Leopardstown in December; however, he produced a career-best performance when a close second in this 12 months ago (good to soft), pulling clear with Gentleman De Mee, and the return to Aintree could spark a revival; on the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Will The Wise
runners_data.comment: Best of the rest behind Madara in the Plate at Cheltenham and open to further improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive over fences this season and took another step forward in a first-time tongue-tie (retained) when best of the rest behind easy winner Madara in the 23-runner Plate at last month's Cheltenham Festival (2m4f, good to soft); this lightly raced 7yo is open to further improvement; chance.

runners_data.name: Theatre Native
runners_data.comment: Impressive on good ground at Cheltenham last April but hasn't reproduced that form since
runners_data.spotlight: Genuine good ground would aid her cause as she was an impressive winner on such going in a mares' novice handicap at Cheltenham (2m4f) last April; however, unable to reproduce that form since and she was always behind in the Plate at Cheltenham (2m4f, good to soft) last month.

runners_data.name: Indiana Jones
runners_data.comment: Grade 3 novice chase win in March 2023 but nowhere near that level in last two seasons
runners_data.spotlight: He won a Grade 3 novice chase in March 2023 but this 10yo has been nowhere near that level across the last two seasons.

runners_data.name: Coming Up Easy
runners_data.comment: Mistakes costly when pulled up at Cheltenham last November; 3-3 in h'cap chases previously
runners_data.spotlight: Mistakes costly when pulled up in the Paddy Power Gold Cup at Cheltenham (2m4f, soft) last November when last seen; however, this front-runner was 3-3 in handicap chases previously, the latest win a convincing one at Killarney (2m5f, good to yielding) in August; certainly remains of interest.

runners_data.name: Johnny's Jury
runners_data.comment: Albert Bartlett winner; this flatter, sharper course could ask different questions of him
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten in one run for Nicky Henderson but now 3-3 for current yard after coming from the clouds in the Albert Bartlett at Cheltenham last month (3m, soft); that win seemed unlikely when out the back for much of the race, and even two out he had more in front than behind him; evidently a strong stayer but this flatter, sharper course could ask different questions of him.

runners_data.name: Seaniecon
runners_data.comment: Beaten under a penalty last time; this stiffest test yet likely to prove well beyond him
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner who was odds-on when winning a maiden at Hereford (3m1f, heavy) and then came up short under a penalty at Uttoxeter (2m4f); this stiffest test yet is likely to prove well beyond him.

runners_data.name: Zeus Power
runners_data.comment: 5yos don't have a great record in this but he was eyecatching in the Turners at Cheltenham
runners_data.spotlight: After minor wins in Ireland he went off 50-1 for the 2m5f Grade 1 Turners at Cheltenham but he defied those odds to finish third, in spite of so much going wrong during the race (got behind after suffering interference); the manner in which he stayed on offers plenty of encouragement for this extra yardage; it's a nagging concern that only four 5yos have won this since 1988 but intriguing otherwise.

runners_data.name: Mondoui'boy
runners_data.comment: Fared best of those who raced prominently when fourth in the Albert Bartlett
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner who ran well in defeat in bumpers at top tracks before selling for £115,000 at the David Maxwell dispersal sale; they were easy pickings at Ludlow (2m5f) and Ascot (2m3f; again good to soft; favourite both times) but he confirmed himself high class (as his trainer had indicated) when fourth to Johnny's Jury in the Albert Bartlett at Cheltenham, where he was in the firing line throughout and fared best of those who raced prominently; provided that race hasn't left a mark then he's of major interest.

runners_data.name: No Drama This End
runners_data.comment: Not his fault when relinquishing his unbeaten record over hurdles at Cheltenham
runners_data.spotlight: Some feat to win a pair of Grade 2s and a Grade 1 on his first three starts over hurdles (2m4f-2m5f; soft/good); he was always on the back foot after a slow start (not his fault) in the 2m5f Grade 1 at Cheltenham last month, which was a non-event for him and Harry Cobden (who now rides stablemate Talk To The Man) accepted matters a long way from home; held in the highest regard by Paul Nicholls, he's clearly a strong contender now sent over a trip that should benefit him.

runners_data.name: Kripticjim
runners_data.comment: Never came up the hill in the Albert Bartlett but ran well for a long way at 22-1
runners_data.spotlight: Tongue tied the last twice; completed his hat-trick in a 2m4f Grade 2 at Cheltenham on Trials' Day (soft; fine on good) but only sixth in the Albert Bartlett; however, he ran well for a long way in fairness only to wilt up the hill and this flatter track could be a better fit; not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Good Girl Kathleen
runners_data.comment: Career best needed and by some way, but trainer's reputation speaks for itself
runners_data.spotlight: It was never in doubt when showing huge improvement in a Grade 3 at Cork (3m, soft to heavy) and when a disappointing favourite for a Grade 2 at Warwick there were apparent excuses; career best needed and by some way, but trainer's reputation speaks for itself; couldn't rule out.

runners_data.name: Frankie John
runners_data.comment: Twice well beaten in Grade 1s (2m4f/2m6f) since his maiden win over Christmas
runners_data.spotlight: Talented Irish raider but with questions to answer at this level having twice finished well beaten in Grade 1s (2m4f/2m6f) since winning a maiden at Leopardstown over Christmas; the cheekpieces are new.

runners_data.name: Talk To The Man
runners_data.comment: Has looked promising in winning his two novices and held in high regard at his top yard
runners_data.spotlight: Irish point winner; couldn't win a bumper but he's looked good in winning two novice hurdles, last time justifying market support with an oh-so-easy win under a penalty at Newbury (2m4f, good to soft; runner-up useful); dangerously unexposed and highly rated in a top yard that's also represented by No Drama This End; interesting, and stamina shouldn't be an issue when he's by Walk In The Park and his dam is a sister to Cheltenham Gold Cup winner Lord Windermere.

runners_data.name: Dalston Lad
runners_data.comment: Fresher than some having had a two-month break since his Grade 2 win at Haydock
runners_data.spotlight: He's gone 3-3 since the cheekpieces went on and it was pretty straightforward from the front in a Grade 2 at Haydock the last time (3m, good to soft) when 4l too good for the strong-finishing Ubatuba who ran a respectable seventh in the Albert Bartlett; arrives here fresher than some; respected.

runners_data.name: Harbour Island
runners_data.comment: 2m3f/2m4f winner; mixed messages on pedigree as to whether this trip will help or not
runners_data.spotlight: Dual bumper winner; lacked the gears to mix it with top 2m novices earlier in the season but, raised in distance, he wasn't overly troubled to win minor races at Taunton (2m3f, good to soft) and Ffos Las (2m4f, heavy); mixed messages on pedigree as to whether this far will be a help or a hindrance, but can't be dismissed.

runners_data.name: Catchintsavo
runners_data.comment: Progressive but finished some 10l behind Mondoui'boy at Ascot in his penultimate race
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive novice but this is his first time in a Graded race of any nature and he finished some 10l behind Mondoui'boy at Ascot on his penultimate start; he'd be a surprise winner.

runners_data.name: Shadow Paddy
runners_data.comment: Has made rapid progress but this might be a step too far, especially with stamina to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Has made rapid progress since winning a low-grade handicap at Tipperary last May, last time securing a fourth career win at Listed level at Limerick (2m5f, yielding) in October; has earned his right to a crack at something better but this might be a step too far, especially with stamina to prove.

races.name: Debenhams Handicap Hurdle (Conditional Jockeys' And Amateur Riders' Race) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Wreckless Eric
runners_data.comment: Runner-up in last two Imperial Cups at Sandown; claims if showing up here in same form
runners_data.spotlight: Returned to form in first-time cheekpieces (retained) when runner-up in the Imperial Cup at Sandown (2m, soft) for the second year in succession; 12 months ago he followed up with a disappointing effort at this meeting but that was over 2m4f and this is more his trip.

runners_data.name: Litleangel Duseuil
runners_data.comment: Ayr stable debut win was a surprise judged on 33-1 SP but there was no fluke about it
runners_data.spotlight: French recruit whose British debut success at Ayr after wind surgery (also tongue-tied first time) seemingly came as a bit of a surprise to connections judged on her 33-1 SP but there was no fluke about it; 7lb higher in a much stronger race now, though.

runners_data.name: Harry Lowes
runners_data.comment: Progressive; excuse on handicap debut and won his second novice hurdle since; big player
runners_data.spotlight: Met trouble at a crucial stage when fifth in a warm race on 2m4f Windsor handicap debut in January and made it 2-2 at around 2m when seeing off four rivals in Bangor novice (soft) the following month; remains open to improvement back in a handicap and capable of having a big say for last year's winning trainer/jockey combination.

runners_data.name: Captain Ryan Matt
runners_data.comment: Handicapper hit him hard for easy Tramore win on New Year's Day but he may do better again
runners_data.spotlight: Second Tramore success when easily seeing off nine rivals in a 2m1f handicap (soft; first win was on good) on New Year's Day; the handicapper hasn't missed him but there may be more to come for his leading Irish stable.

runners_data.name: Sherminator
runners_data.comment: Won all four completed starts over hurdles and probably more to come; considered
runners_data.spotlight: Has won all four completed starts over hurdles (trained by Emma Lavelle for first win); came 6l clear on handicap debut at Exeter (2m, good to soft) last time in the style of one who can keep on improving; considered under Patrick Mullins.

runners_data.name: Star Of Guiting
runners_data.comment: Two Musselburgh wins this winter but latest fifth there suggests his mark is about right
runners_data.spotlight: Two 1m7f Musselburgh wins this winter; bounced back from a poor run in the Imperial Cup when fifth of 14 back at Musselburgh three weeks ago but that effort suggests the handicapper is winning the argument for now.

runners_data.name: Pourquoi Pas Papa
runners_data.comment: Likeable sort who was an excellent fourth in Fred Winter; a must for the shortlist
runners_data.spotlight: Likeable sort who finished out of the first two for the first time but ran as well as he's ever done when fourth of 22 in the Fred Winter (Handicap) at last month's Cheltenham Festival (2m, good to soft; The Mighty Celt sixth); that effort can be marked up slightly as he got messed about a bit turning in; Paul Nicholls won this in 2022 and sent out the second in 2023 and the third (Afadil) in 2024; a must for the shortlist.

runners_data.name: The Mighty Celt
runners_data.comment: Eyecatcher on both starts for Dan Skelton and has bigger performances in him
runners_data.spotlight: French recruit who has caught the eye on both starts for Dan Skelton, latterly making good late headway from the rear for sixth of 22 in the Fred Winter (Handicap) at Cheltenham (2m, good to soft); could do with learning to settle better but there are bigger performances in him if he can.

runners_data.name: Wandering Ego
runners_data.comment: Two novice hurdle wins and he was third in a warm race in his sole handicap; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Second 2m novice hurdle success when comfortably seeing off 11 rivals at Huntingdon 23 days ago; third in a 2m Kempton race (again on good) which has worked out well in his sole handicap; respected for a stable which has had a few run well in this in recent years.

runners_data.name: Mr McLoughlan
runners_data.comment: Has had a good season but the handicapper seems in charge for now
runners_data.spotlight: Novice who won three times in the autumn (2m, good to soft/good) but it seems the handicapper has caught up, as he finished only sixth off this mark at Haydock last Saturday.

runners_data.name: Last Kingdom
runners_data.comment: Below par in three quick runs for this yard but dropped 10lb; tongue-tie on; check betting
runners_data.spotlight: Won a big-field Listed handicap at Listowel (2m, good to yielding; first-time cheekpieces) for Willie Mullins in September; hasn't got anywhere near that level in three outings without headgear for his new yard in recent months but his mark has dropped 10lb; worth a second look in the betting with a tongue-tie tried now.

runners_data.name: Laafi
runners_data.comment: Good fifth in strong handicap hurdles on his last two starts; each-way claims
runners_data.spotlight: Very useful on the Flat and has quickly reached a similar level over hurdles, finishing a creditable fifth in strong, big-field handicaps at Leopardstown (yielding) and Kelso (also 2m, good to soft) on his last two outings; each-way claims.

runners_data.name: Static
runners_data.comment: Last two starts yielded 2m3f wins but 0-10 at around 2m in Britain prior to that
runners_data.spotlight: On a hat-trick after 2m3f wins at Haydock (good to soft) and Bangor (good) under Charlie Maggs last month but the fact he failed to win at around 2m on his first ten starts in Britain hardly boosts confidence in him for this drop back in trip.

runners_data.name: Melon
runners_data.comment: Placed in two of three handicaps this term, latterly chasing home Rubber Ball at Newbury
runners_data.spotlight: Two juvenile hurdle wins last winter; reappeared with a good third of 11 in handicap at Cheltenham (2m1f, good to soft) in December and bounced back quickly from a lesser effort at Windsor when chasing home the reopposing Rubber Ball at Newbury (2m, good to soft) in February.

runners_data.name: Afadil
runners_data.comment: On a long losing run but often competitive; possibly failed to stay 2m5f latest
runners_data.spotlight: 18 races and over two years since his last win, albeit still frequently competitive; below par over 2m5f at Ascot only 12 days ago but his peak form has come at around 2m (third in this in 2024).

runners_data.name: Rubber Ball
runners_data.comment: Easily saw off Melon at Newbury and his next run possibly came too soon; not dismissed
runners_data.spotlight: Returned to form with a bang when seeing off the reopposing Melon at Newbury (2m, good to soft) in February; has a quick turnaround as an excuse for a lesser effort in the Imperial Cup at Sandown (2m, soft) one week later, while his trainer reported to the stewards that he'll be suited by a flatter track and a quicker surface, both of which he should get today; not dismissed.

runners_data.name: No Ordinary Joe
runners_data.comment: Ascot fifth in February provides hope but held twice since; visor needs to give him a lift
runners_data.spotlight: On a long losing spell but he was bang there for a long way when fifth in a warm 2m3f handicap at Ascot in February with cheekpieces added; hasn't reproduced that in two subsequent starts but it's possible that a change of headgear (first-time visor now) could give him a lift.

runners_data.name: Charlus
runners_data.comment: No promise in 2m5f handicaps since joining Dan Skelton, so others are more obvious
runners_data.spotlight: No promise in handicaps around 2m5f (Martin Pipe at Cheltenham latterly) since joining Dan Skelton; his hurdle form for Willie Mullins came at around 2m, so it's possible the drop back in trip will help, but the yard's other runners hold more obvious claims.

runners_data.name: Wild Bill Hickok
runners_data.comment: Listed win in France last April but out of form there in the autumn; changed hands since
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Listed Hurdle for 3yos at Auteuil (1m7f, heavy) for Noel George & Amanda Zetterholm last April but badly out of sorts when last seen in the autumn; picked up by new connections for 52,000euros in November; a watching brief is the percentage call.

runners_data.name: Ehteyat
runners_data.comment: Placed in maiden hurdles but opening hurdle mark of 125 looks quite tough
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner; placed in three of four maiden hurdles at up to an extended 2m1f in Ireland this year but doesn't strike as being obviously well treated from an opening hurdle mark in the mid-120s.

runners_data.name: Gooloogong
runners_data.comment: Won handicap hurdle debut at Kempton but well beaten in the Imperial Cup since
runners_data.spotlight: In good form on AW Flat last spring and returned from an absence for 50-1 win on handicap hurdle debut at Kempton (2m, good to soft) in February; weakened quickly in the Imperial Cup at Sandown (soft) but perhaps a return to less testing ground may help.

runners_data.name: Hamsiyann
runners_data.comment: Best hurdle form at around 2m5f, so this shorter trip is not sure to suit after his break
runners_data.spotlight: Justified strong market support in 2m5f Cheltenham handicap (good) in November 2024; belatedly back to that sort of form when second of six at Newcastle (extended 2m4f, good to soft) in November but let down by his jumping when only a respectable fourth at Kempton (2m5f, good) over Christmas; drops back in trip for his first run since.
